title: Certify Z3's one-argument xor through both proof cores
summary: The Lean reconstructor and the clause-log exporter now accept Z3's one-argument xor, render it as its argument, and prove its two gate clauses, so inputs such as z3test 3434.smt2 are certified through both proof cores without axioms. Python examples, tests, and docs only; zero and three-or-more argument xor nodes stay rejected.
